comment: restore.c restgamestate():704-705 gh.hero_seq = svm.moves << 3: hero_seq is not saved. A gnomish Healer searches twice, so allmain.c moveloop_core():396 has left hero_seq at moves * 8 + 1, listens to herself with her stethoscope (apply.c use_stethoscope():340-341, free, and svc.context.stethoscope_seq takes that value and is saved), and saves. The second segment restores with hero_seq back at moves * 8, so the next stethoscope use is free again and only the one after it takes a move; the time option shows the turn counter. Seeds, datetimes, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
